The switch inside the details works fine — flipping "Read later" on there is clear enough, and it's a sensible place to have it when I'm already in a bookmark's details looking things over. But beside the one-click clock on the card, this feels like more work for the same result: I have to open the details first just to flip a switch, when most of the time I just want to glance at a link in my list and tap "later, please."

So I'll stick with my choice — the one-click card action as the main way to flag something. Having the switch in the details too is a nice bonus for when I'm already in there, so keep both if it's easy, but the card button is the one I'd reach for.
